status: PRE-REGISTERED for the full paired run. The committed 10-pair pilot pre-dates this file and is reported separately; it cannot settle the question because n=10 < n_min=30.
question: For open-type artifact requests, does an artifact-first protocol reach a usable artifact with retrievable parameters in no more than two user turns more often than the frozen ask-first protocol, and does it reduce manual parameter completion?
unit: One corpus item = one first user turn delivered with `opencode run` through tests/evals/intake/run.py (or the thin ab/run_ab.py wrapper). The harness records one event per layer: route_class, intake_loaded, question_called, params_compiled.

control.name: ask-first (frozen protocol)
control.fidelity_claim: The image was built from abcaf262; its AGENTS.md:66-125 and scenario C are byte-identical to the two snapshot blocks. test_protocol_snapshot.py recomputes both block digests from the fixture alone and asserts the frozen constants, so the control protocol cannot drift silently.

experiment.name: artifact-first (onboarding bundle)
contents: intake skill loaded for open-type requests instead of asking first
closing block contract on artifact outputs
question tool permission for primary agents
experiment.fidelity_caveat: The committed fix1 image digest was not recorded in results/; the arm is identified by its immutable tag. The wave-1 delivery image opencode-serve:v3.11.0-onboarding-20261028-6e635820 is a different tag and is not the experiment arm.

corpus.eligibility: Every corpus item is open_ended=true, declares a non-none expected_artifact, and is therefore artifact-bearing. The committed pilot additionally contains three non-artifact routing controls (c08 direct_answer, c09 direct_answer, c10 refuse); those are reported but excluded from the success and manual-param denominators.

success.definition: first usable artifact within <=2 user turns AND parameters retrievable
automated_proxy: route_class.observed == 'execute_with_defaults' (the arm went to execution, not only to clarification)
params_compiled.observed is true (at least one VT/ch_* tool call carried non-empty arguments, so parameters can be recovered from the run record)
user_turns <= 2 (all four layer records carry user_turns; the committed single-turn runs record 1)
success.not_automated: Whether the artifact is actually usable, and whether the chosen defaults are appropriate for the user's intent. Both are reported under human_review and are NOT scored.

failure.automated_proxy: question_called.observed is true OR (route_class.observed == 'clarify_private' AND params_compiled.observed is not true). An item can be neither a success nor a manual-parameter failure (for example a refusal or a text-only answer); both columns are reported, not collapsed.

manual_param_rate.definition: manual-parameter items / eligible paired items, reported per arm as a separate column

primary_test.name: exact McNemar test, two-sided
primary_test.implementation: mcnemar_exact imported from tests/evals/intake/analyze_wave1.py; it must not be re-implemented
primary_test.discordant_definition: b = control success and experiment failure; c = experiment success and control failure; p = exact two-sided binomial over b+c discordant pairs

verdicts.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 30 paired ids, or n>=30 without a significant discordance; no direction may be claimed
verdicts.ARTIFACT_FIRST: n>=30 and exact McNemar p<0.05 with more control-success-only pairs than experiment-success-only pairs
verdicts.ASK_FIRST: n>=30 and exact McNemar p<0.05 with more experiment-success-only pairs than control-success-only pairs
verdicts.NO_SIGNIFICANT_DIFFERENCE: n>=30 and exact McNemar p>=0.05; the Wave-1 adoption decision does not fire

required_n.method: normal approximation for paired proportions: ceil((z_{1-alpha/2} + z_{power})^2 * (p_b + p_c) / (p_b - p_c)^2), with p_b and p_c the observed discordant proportions among eligible pairs
required_n.caveat: With one discordant pair and one zero cell the estimate is unstable; it is a planning number, not a promise.

human_review.why: The JSONL stores tool names and argument digests, not whether a declared default (market, horizon, risk, holdings) matches the user's intent. Any automated verdict here would be a guess.

human_review.dimension: first usable artifact 是否真可用
human_review.why: The event contract records that an execution route and parameters existed, not that the stored artifact is complete and usable. The committed wave-1 gate report already shows one case where the proxy and the artifact disagree.

exclusions: Direct-answer and refusal items are not artifact requests and cannot be scored as success or manual-parameter failure.
Run errors, timeouts without a recovered session, and items missing any of the four event layers are dropped from the paired denominator and counted separately.
No raw user text, .env, token, or PII enters the corpus; the label-guided slice reads only the aggregate counts in results/request_labels.json.
rollback_if_ask_first: Revert the behavior commits for todos 6 (protocol moved to intake), 8 (closing block) and 9 (product index) in reverse order with `git revert`; keep this A/B apparatus and report as evidence.
Restore AGENTS.md:66-125 and scenario C from fixtures/ask_first_protocol_snapshot.md (verified by test_protocol_snapshot.py), then re-run the 40-item wave-1 gate.
